view.intro:
The scroll lies restored, as Lepsius drew it.

Walk [b]right to left[/b] with [←] [→] or click the papyrus. Click a figure or caption to walk up to it and read its description. Open the Journal with [j].
view.start: The scroll lies restored. Walk it and read what is drawn.
view.hint: Nothing here needs doing. Walk the scroll and click any figure or caption to read about it.
